description: Demolition of existing side extension and erection of single storey side extension. Extension of front brick boundary wall and insertion of gate. Erection of a cycle store and plant room to side of house. Replacement of all windows and alterations to existing side/rear fenestration of main house. Installation of solar panels to existing rear roof extension. Re-cladding and fenestration alterations to existing outbuilding, with addition of one solar panel in rear roof slope.
decision_conditions: Condition : 1 - The development hereby permitted shall be begun before the expiration of three years from the date of this permission.

Condition : 2 - The materials to be used in the construction of the external surfaces of the extension hereby permitted shall match those used in the existing building, unless otherwise shown on the approved drawings.

Condition : 3 - The proposed development shall be carried out in all respects in accordance with the proposals contained in the application and the plans submitted (Drawings AS01, AB 01(G), AB02(F), AB03 (E), AB04(E), CM/20579/T, CM/20579/GND, CM/20579/1ST, CM/20579/2ND, CM/20579/ELE and CM/20579/S and Design and Access Statement, received 10/05/2021) therewith and approved by the Local Planning Authority, or as shall have been otherwise agreed in writing by the Local Planning Authority before the building is used.

Condition : 4 - The detached single storey outbuilding hereby approved shall only be used for a purpose incidental to the enjoyment of the house at the '66 Park Road, W4 3HL' and for no other purpose (for example, it may not be used as a self-contained dwelling or contain a bedroom, living room, bathroom, kitchen or other primary residential accommodation, nor may it be used for business purposes).

Condition : 5 - The dwelling house, as enlarged in accordance with this permission, shall only be used as a single unit of accommodation, and shall not be subdivided, separated or altered in any way so as to create two or more separate units of accommodation, without further grant of planning permission.
